The Subtask Name: Create Product Requirement Document (PRD)
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Product Manager
  To_agent: Product Manager
  agent_dependency_type: reasoning_continuation
  agent_strength: 0.95

  agent_failure_modes:

      description: The agent may repeatedly insert content at incorrect line numbers or overwrite existing content due to miscounting lines after previous insertions.
      severity: 0.8

    - type: data_issue

The Subtask Name: Design Software Architecture
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Architect

  agent_strength: 0.9

  agent_failure_modes:

      severity: 0.6

    - type: irrecoverability_issue

      severity: 0.5
